## HaloBar 0.0.6

### New
- **A clipboard that keeps up.** The clipboard widget is now a full manager: fuzzy search, pins, tabs for text, code, links, files, media and colours, list or grid, previews while you hold Alt, code highlighting with seven themes, colour swatches in about twenty notations, and links cleaned of tracking. Pick an item and it pastes straight into the app you came from (Shift for plain text), or open it with Alt+Shift+V. Pause it any time, and it skips password managers and the apps and sites you list.
- **Smoother sliders.** Bigger, easier to grab, with a value bubble while you drag and wheel steps.

### Faster
- **Out of a game's way.** Behind a fullscreen game HaloBar draws nothing, stops its checks and steps down in priority, while a dock on another screen keeps working.
- **About half the memory and a third of the idle CPU**, with animations held to 60 fps on high-refresh screens.

### Fixes
- Closing a panel could empty your notes if they had never been opened.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
